cues.text: Test 4.
This is the IELTS listening test.
You will hear a number of different recordings and you will have to answer questions on what you hear.
There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions and you will have a chance to check your work.
All the recordings will be played once only.
The test is in four parts.
At the end of the test, you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to an answer sheet.
You will hear a man asking a friend for advice on things to do in the city with a family of visitors.
First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 6.
Now listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 6.
Sandra, I seem to remember you had some family visitors staying with you recently.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yeah, that's right.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: My brother and his family were here a couple of months ago.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: OK, good.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Well, I wanted to ask your advice.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I've got my cousin and her family visiting next month and as I don't have kids, I've no idea where to take them.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: What about accommodation?
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Are they going to stay with you in your flat?
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: No, thankfully.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: There wouldn't be room.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: My cousin wants me to recommend a hotel.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Do you know anywhere?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yes, I do actually.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: I always recommend people stay at the King's Hotel.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Where's that near?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: It's about five minutes walk from Murray Station, so nice and central.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: It's actually on George Street.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Oh yes, I know.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I think they're on quite a tight budget.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: So how much, roughly, is it to stay there?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: If you book a family room, it's about £125 per night.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: My brother paid for two double rooms in the end and I think that was around £95 for each room.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Oh, that's not too bad.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: So how old are your cousin's kids?
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Twelve and nine.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: So I want to organise some trips while they're here.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I was thinking of doing a bus tour of the city centre as none of them have been here before.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Those bus tours are quite expensive.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: I think it's better to do a walking tour.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: It gives you a much better feel for the city.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: There's one that starts from Colton Square.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: It takes a couple of hours and doesn't cost that much.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Sounds good.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I'll look that up.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Thanks.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: If the weather's nice, one thing you could do is visit the old fort.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: You could get there by boat.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: The whole trip takes half a day.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: That's a really good idea.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I'd like to do that myself.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: And if the weather's bad, I was thinking they could go to the Science Museum.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: But maybe they could do that when I'm at work.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yeah, don't forget it's closed on Mondays.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: They're here from Saturday for four nights, so Tuesday would be best, I think.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: And it won't be so crowded then.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Saturdays are terrible.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: I took my kids to the exhibition on old computers there and it was far too crowded.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: I wanted to go back but it's finished now.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: That's a shame.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: My cousin's kids would have enjoyed that.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: There's another one starting soon on Space, which looks really good too.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: OK, well, I'll mention that to my cousin.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions seven to ten.
Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.
Have you thought about where to take them to eat?
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Well, I really like all the food stalls at Clacton Market.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: My cousin's vegetarian.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I know it's one of the best places for that kind of food.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Definitely.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: And there'll be loads of choice for the kids too.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: You need to get there quite early though.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: At the weekend, most of the stalls stop serving lunch at 2.30.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Good point. It's all going to need careful planning.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: My cousin said she'd love to take the kids to a show at the theatre, but tickets are so expensive.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I know.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: But you can get some good deals if you book online with bargain-tickets.com for the following day.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: On some seats there's a 75% discount.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Really?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I must try and get some.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yeah.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: There are lots of things you can do for free as well.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: No need to spend a fortune.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Like what?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: They're coming next month, right?
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Well, check and see if it's the same weekend as the Roots Music Festival in Blakewell Gardens.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: R-O-O-T-S?
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yeah, check it out online.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: It's always a family-friendly event and there's no entry charge.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: That sounds perfect.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: And if you're in Blakewell Gardens, climb Telegraph Hill.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: You'll be able to look right down on the port.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Everyone's always really impressed because it's so huge.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Oh yeah, I've been meaning to do that for ages.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: I've heard the view's amazing.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Yeah, it's really worth the effort.
cues.speaker: SANDRA

cues.text: Well, that's given me loads of ideas.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: Thanks so much.
cues.speaker: MAN

cues.text: That is the end of part one.
You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
